links.outcome: Self-rated generative AI competency after brief didactic and lab training on ChatGPT use and limitations
links.effect: All 10 students reported increasing self-rated generative AI competency by one to two points on a five-point scale; they identified strengths and limitations of ChatGPT across three tasks.
links.quote: All of them reported increasing their self-rated competency in generative AI by one to two points on a five-point rating scale.

screen.reason: Empirically evaluates an educational intervention designed to train doctoral nursing students on appropriate generative AI use cases, limitations, and safety evaluations.

primary.practice: generative AI training / education for clinicians and researchers
